changelog:
Initial release of AI Agent platform deployment skill for Huawei Cloud Flexus L:

- Enables one-click deployment of the Dify AI Agent development platform on Flexus L instances.
- Supports secure admin password management, including password change operations.
- Allows addition and configuration of MaaS model providers (DeepSeek, Qwen).
- Provides workflow template viewing and quick import into the platform.
- Ensures robust credential and execution security, with strict rules for handling sensitive information.
- All deployment, configuration, and operational scripts are executed securely within the skill environment.
summary: Deploy AI Agent development platform (Dify) on Huawei Cloud Flexus L instance, providing deployment operations, password management, MaaS model configuration...
